scenes.summary: You return to the Stasis Core aboard Dijiang. With Perlica's assistance, you attempt to recover some of your memories. There is nothing at first, but then you suddenly catch a glimpse of a mysterious flame...

lines.text: Did you have any dreams recently? What did you see in those dreams?
Is that so...
It's alright, Endmin. You have a strong bond to this land. Those feelings will slowly come back.
As we journey on, you will encounter more people and events connected to you. Perhaps a day will come ... when your lost memories return.
Hm? A flash of fire...?
It's okay. Take a deep breath and close your eyes. Try and recall what's happened so far...

options: I recalled ... none of my pre-awakening memories.
I mostly recalled the events of Valley IV...

lines.text: Traces on the Protocol Singularity... Something's off.

options: Touch it
Observe for a while

scenes.summary: Mysterious traces caught your attention and you suddenly find yourself in an unfamiliar icefield. You then meet a red-haired Sarkaz girl. She learns that you are lost and agrees to lead you out of the place.

lines.text: A place you shouldn't be.
Leave now, for your own good.
Oh? How unexpected... Another intruder in this place.
You're lost? Getting out won't be easy, unless you "remember".
You clearly don't understand, do you? Well then, follow me.

options: What is this place...?
So how should I ... leave this place?
"Remember" what?

scenes.summary: You discover that this is a Protocol Space strewn with fragments of memories. The red-haired girl wants to find her lost memories in this place.

lines.text: You fight well, even though you don't look it.
No wonder. I can feel that ... meeting you here is no simple coincidence.
Not only did I lose my memories ... my mind's filled with experiences that weren't even mine to begin with.
This is a place constructed with memories. Everything we see is taken from our memories and transcribed by Originium.
"Protocol Space"? That's the name, huh... What about you? Are you here looking for memories too?
Only those who forgot their past end up in this place. And you happen to be one of them.
Worse than that.
Including those monsters.
Let's move. We'll search around for hidden memories, then I'll take you out of this place.
So I found a way to come here. I'll figure out where I'm from, what I actually did, and ... who I'm *actually* supposed to be.
What do you think? I came here chasing after them.

options: What exactly ... is all this?
I ... I lost my memories. A lot of it, actually.
Did you lose your memories too?
Originium, data shards... We're in a Protocol Space.
Can you find lost memories here...?

scenes.summary: The red-haired girl sees writing that describes her. She once ventured into an icefield in search of her own memories.

lines.text: This is my past. I ran to the middle of an icefield alone in search for buried truths.
Yes. A very long time ago — it almost felt like someone else's experience.
Dreams... They're like memories at times. Feel almost real while they happen. But when you think back on them later ... you'd realize how ridiculous they are.
Let's keep looking.
A dream?

options: Did that happen a long time ago?
I only have a weird dream about the distant past.
All other memories were made after waking up from it.

scenes.summary: A prayer about the worship of fire. It reminds the red-haired girl of fire and a greatsword. However, she is uncertain if this memory belongs to her.

lines.text: In those memories, I vanquished countless foes with fire and a greatsword.
But why was I fighting? Who were the enemies? And are those memories truly mine...?
Everything remains unknown.
This prayer again...
Yes.
I have all sorts of memories ... where "I" was in different situations, had different identities, and did different things.
Hmph. I hope not.

options: Unknown?
Seems like fanatics who worship some kind of fire.
Perhaps this prayer described ... a possibility?

scenes.summary: A short poem about fallen warriors. It gives the red-haired girl fuzzy memories of fighting in a snowy icefield.

lines.text: Warriors of the icefield. I once stood alongside them as we faced something beyond our understanding.
Oh? Tell me more about it.
Yes. But ... I couldn't recall the outcomes of that battle.
Mission? Your memories are making me curious.

options: You fought in an icefield?
I have similar experiences in an icefield as well...
It was a battle ... and an important mission...

scenes.summary: The engravings describe a flaming sword cursed to devour its wielder. The weapon seems related to the sword wielded by the red-haired girl. However, you fail to gather other details.

lines.text: Those who pick it up will be granted tremendous power.
But the sword shall burn on until its wielder turns to cinders.
It's very quiet now, at least.
I once saw a sword like this...
Looks like it ... though not quite.
Regardless, this isn't important.

options: Is it the one you're holding right now?

scenes.summary: A strange illusion sharing the exact likeness of the red-haired girl appears. The illusion attempts to stop the red-haired girl from recovering her memories. A battle then commences.

lines.text: Until I find out who I am, there is no stopping me.
We meet again. You're actually slower this time.
Damn you. Are you trying to stop me again?
Ooh. You've got a companion? This feels rather refreshing.
Give up already. This is for your own good.
Then enjoy your aimless wandering ... till oblivion takes you.
Don't you understand? I'll never try to "stop" you. In fact, isn't my presence here the result you seek?
Enough nonsense. There'll be no escape for you this time.
There are things you aren't meant to find... Let them disappear.
Stop right there!

options: Are you alright?

scenes.summary: The red-haired girl explains that the illusion has attempted to stop her many times. She intends to chase down the illusion and recover the past. After confirming your identity as the Endministrator, she sets off on her own and continues her search for memories.

lines.text: It's an old wound. There's no way those creatures could hurt me.
I will ... find you!
There were times when I came close to the truth ... but she had to ruin it all.
Chase her down. I must reclaim my memories.
Hmm... We shouldn't stay here any longer. In any case, thank you for your assistance, Endmin.
It's not that hard of a guess. I can't think of anyone else who could enter a Protocol Space unscathed, fight Aggeloi, and run a pretty important mission...
Meeting you has been fun...
Someone who's always getting in my way.
I've searched many places, but mostly in vain. This version of "me" always shows up at the very end.
Until next time.

options: Are you hurt?
Who's that thing that looks like you?
What are you doing next?
How did you...

scenes.summary: You leave the Protocol Space and wake up in the Stasis Core. Perlica learns about your encounter and starts looking into this matter. Meanwhile, Fiona the comms officer reports the sighting of mysterious fires and strange Originium reactions in Valley IV. You suspect this is associated with the red-haired girl and decide to investigate.

lines.text: Endmin! Are you alright?
What just happened?
Who is she...?
That does not sound normal...
But I'm afraid we lack enough evidence to reach a proper conclusion.
Did you just enter a Protocol Space...? This is quite unexpected...
I'll try to look into this. Wait for my updates.
Hi, Endmin! We recently picked up a few strange Originium reactions across Valley IV. And —
Witness reports also mentioned some form of fire that accompanied those Originium reactions...
Wha? Endmin, you have a lead on this?
Then perhaps it is best to have you investigate this. I'll sync the coordinates to you.
The Protocol Space is essentially a data shard within Originium... And if it includes data from past memories, they might be recreated within the Space as well.
But finding the memories of a particular person is difficult. It's like hunting for a needle in a haystack.

options: I just touched it and found myself in an icefield...
I met a red-haired Sarkaz girl who wields a sword...
I'm not sure. She's also looking for her memories.
And what?
Fires...? Is she the cause of this?
She's also opposed by a shadow that resembles her.
Yeah. Someone looking for lost memories. Like me.
She's very mysterious. She even knows I'm the Endmin.
